topic: Country with the most time zones: France, 12 (metropolitan France plus overseas departments and territories from French Polynesia at UTC−10 to Wallis and Futuna at UTC+12); Russia 11 (UTC+2 Kaliningrad to UTC+12 Kamchatka); United States 11 including territories (UTC−12 Baker Island to UTC+10 Guam, 6 across the 50 states); China spans about five geographic zones but uses one official time (UTC+8).
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Russia has the most time zones because it is the widest country.
myths.reality: Russia has 11 across one landmass; France reaches 12 through overseas territories from Tahiti to Wallis and Futuna.

tad_france.title: Time zones in France
tad_france.notes: France and its dependencies use 12 time zones, from UTC−10 (Tahiti, French Polynesia) to UTC+12 (Wallis and Futuna); Paris UTC+1/+2

tad_russia.title: Time zones in Russia
tad_russia.notes: Russia uses 11 time zones, UTC+2 (Kaliningrad) to UTC+12 (Kamchatka)

tad_usa.title: Time zones in the United States
tad_usa.notes: the USA and its dependencies use 11 time zones (UTC−12 to UTC+10); 6 across the 50 states

tad_china.title: Time zones in China
tad_china.notes: China uses a single time zone, China Standard Time UTC+8, although it spans five geographic zones

claims.text: France has the most time zones of any country: 12, thanks to its overseas territories.

france. not the hexagon on the map, but its islands around the world: 12 time zones

claims.text: Russia uses 11 time zones across one landmass; the United States, including its territories, also 11.

claims.text: French clocks run from UTC−10 in Tahiti (French Polynesia) to UTC+12 in Wallis and Futuna — 22 hours apart.
vo: its clocks run from tahiti, at utc minus 10, to wallis and futuna, at plus 12: a gap of 22 hours

claims.text: China spans about five geographic time zones but uses a single official time, UTC+8 (Beijing time).
vo: and china, nearly as wide as the united states, picked a single clock: beijing time, everywhere
